title: Super Library Agent: Joint Generation and Maintenance of Multiple Applications Beyond the Single Codebase
abstract: arXiv:2608.29310v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Organizations often develop and maintain portfolios of related applications: independently deployable codebases that share substantial domain logic, interface patterns, or operational conventions. As LLM coding agents are increasingly used to generate and maintain such software, a naive application-by-application workflow duplicates shared logic across codebases and allows prolonged agentic maintenance to accumulate verbosity, dead code, and structural erosion. We introduce the Super Library Agent problem, where an agent sequentially generates a portfolio of N related applications while maintaining a shared Super Library of reusable cross-application components. A minimal sequential scaffold can in principle extract shared code and migrate applications to the evolving library, but in practice suffers from low extraction recall and fragile dependency migration. translated_title: 超级库代理：超越单一代码库的多应用联合生成与维护
translated_abstract: 组织通常需要开发和维护一组相关的应用程序组合：这些是独立可部署的代码库，共享大量的领域逻辑、接口模式或运维惯例。随着大语言模型（LLM）编程代理被越来越多地用于生成和维护此类软件，一种朴素的逐应用工作流会在各代码库之间重复实现共享逻辑，并使长期的代理维护逐渐积累冗余代码、死代码和结构性退化。我们提出了“超级库代理”问题：代理按顺序生成 N 个相关应用程序的组合，同时维护一个由可跨应用复用组件组成的共享超级库。一个最小的顺序脚手架原则上可以提取共享代码并将应用迁移到不断演进的库中，但在实践中存在提取召回率低和依赖迁移脆弱的问题。我们通过基于代码块的候选引导提取方法来解决这些缺陷。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出“超级库代理”问题及候选引导提取方法，使LLM代理能够在按序生成N个相关应用的同时维护一个共享的可复用组件超级库，从而解决跨应用共享代码提取召回率低和依赖迁移脆弱的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Super Library Agent problem and a candidate-guided extraction method that enables LLM agents to sequentially generate N related applications while maintaining a shared Super Library of reusable components, addressing low extraction recall and fragile dependency migration.
